about: Get a replacement for a lost or damaged Emirates ID card.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Emirates ID replacement. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: The new card keeps the validity of the lost or damaged one
The head of the family, a legal representative, a guardian or the person themselves if of legal age can apply
documents: A recent personal photo that meets ICAO standards
fees: Urgent service is 150 AED, in person at a service centre only
timing: Anyone over 15 gives fingerprints and a signature at an ICP service centre
channels: ICP Smart Services website or ICP Smart App (sign in with UAE PASS)
